featured_reviews.name: Neha Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text:
We were searching for banquet hall for my sister's wedding in South Mumbai and we came accross Sanskruti Banquet for general enquiry. Before coming here we had seen and enquired at multiple places but the time and attention we received here was very commendable. Our event was for around 350 people, they carefully listened and undertstood all our requirements and also gave relevant suggestions. Special mention to Mr. Hitul Joshi who throughout was very helpful and managed our event smoothly leaving us stress free. We received many compliments from our guests for all the arrangements - service, decor, ambience and specially for food.
Mr. Salman Sopariwala gave us the best deal and was very considerate. This place is a 10 on 10 recommendation for small and big events. I would like to sincerely thank all the management members for making our function amazing and a memorable experience.

featured_reviews.review_text: We recently attended a marriage function at this venue and had a pleasant experience overall. The hall is quite spacious and well-maintained, making it suitable for weddings, engagements, and other family gatherings. The ambiance is simple yet elegant, with a welcoming atmosphere for guests. The entrance area resembles the steps of a cinema hall, giving it a unique look. The air conditioning was functional and kept the hall fairly comfortable, although it could have been a little stronger given the warm weather. Seating arrangements included standard plastic chairs, neatly covered with clean white satin, which added a touch of grace to the decor. Overall, it's a decent venue for medium-sized functions, offering good value for the price.

featured_reviews.name: Neha Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a party at Sangam Hall (Marine Drive) for my son's 5th birthday and it was an outstanding experience from start to finish. From our initial meeting with Mr. Alok, he was always attentive and detail-oriented. He took the time to understand our preferences, making suggestions that enhanced our plans while remaining within our budget. On the day of the event, everything was executed flawlessly. The venue was beautifully decorated, exactly as we had discussed. The staff was friendly and efficient, ensuring that all our guests were well taken care of. The food was delicious. Event Host Hansa was just spectacular and so multi talented and managed everything so well. We could relax and enjoy the celebration knowing that everything was in capable hands.
Thanks Mr. Alok and the entire team at Sangam Hall. My son's birthday was a memorable and magical experience. I highly recommend their services for any event and I will certainly be returning for future celebrations! Keep up the good work.

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Dere
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently hosted my baby's naming ceremony at Sangam Hall and couldn't be happier with the experience. The services were excellent, and the appetizers were the highlight – extremely tasty! The main course was equally delicious. The staff was very cordial, and the owner, Alok, went above and beyond to personally ensure everything was well-organized and that all our guests were looked after. I highly recommend Sangam Hall for any special occasion. Thank you, Alok, and the entire team for making our event unforgettable!

A big thank you to the owner Alok ji and his entire team for their hard work and dedication in making this celebration so special. Highly recommended for anyone looking to host a flawless and unforgettable event!

featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent hall!! The space might seem a bit small but fits just well. There are 3-4 air conditioners which keep the place super cool and enjoyable and also there are many fans if someone doesn't want the air conditioners. There is a stage which is a little bit small but is very helpful for small functions and parties kinda thing. We had hosted the 'Farewell party' for our seniors and it turned out to be amazinglyyyy littt!!!!!🥵🥳 The lights in the false ceiling changes colours when repeatedly swithed on and off😂so make use of that while dancing or just to create a good vibe!  There is a separate place for arranging food, there is a washroom and also a changing room available. The speakers are also decent but just require Aux cable of an amplifier. The main downside due to which i gave 4 stars is that there are noise restrictions due to the hall being situated in a B.E.S.T. Colony. Otherwise it's a very perfect place to host events and that too in an extremely pocket friendly budget and timings.

featured_reviews.name: Atanu Maity
featured_reviews.review_text:
Small Hall for Functions

￼￼

Its small hall but its very good for small functions

It's great to hear that the small hall is well-suited for hosting small functions! Having a venue that is appropriately sized for your event can make a big difference in creating a comfortable and enjoyable experience for your guests.

If you're planning a small function in the hall, here are a few things you may want to consider:

Capacity: Make sure you know the maximum capacity of the hall and ensure that you don't exceed it. This will help you avoid any safety concerns and ensure that everyone has enough space to move around comfortably.

Amenities: Check to see what amenities the hall provides. For example, does it have a kitchen for food preparation, tables and chairs for guests, or a sound system for music and speeches? Make sure you know what's available so that you can plan accordingly.

Decorations: If you want to decorate the hall, make sure you check with the venue to see what is allowed. Some venues have restrictions on decorations to protect their property.

Catering: If you plan on catering the event, make sure you know what options are available. Some venues have their own catering service, while others may require you to bring in an outside caterer.

By considering these factors, you can help ensure that your small function in the hall is a success.

featured_reviews.name: Trisha Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had a terrible experience with this wedding hall. Initially, I met a person who quoted a certain amount for the hall. However, when I met Mr. Vichare 2-3 days later, he quoted a much higher amount for the same hall, same time, and same decoration. Despite knowing that I had already booked the hall with his higher authority, he was very rude, unprofessional, and irritating.

The management promised a haldi mandap outside the hall with good decoration, but on my special day, they set it up in a congested corner of the hall, which was very disappointing. They also promised 3 rooms for getting ready, but only provided 2, one for the bride and one for the groom, with the groom's room being too small and the washroom being outside, resembling a public toilet.

The management has a monopoly on decorations and food, and they charged exorbitant amounts for basic services. They showed us different photos, but delivered subpar products on our special day. The food was also subpar, and they charged a royalty of Rs 75 per plate for outside catering services.

The staff, including higher authorities, were very rude and unprofessional. They only care about money and didn't bother about our special day. I strongly advise against considering this hall for your wedding. The experience was terrible, and I regret choosing this place."
